skip.url-state: a fixed chart with no editable state: the only interaction is reading a point's value
skip.back-forward: a fixed chart with no editable state, so there is no history to step through
skip.command-palette: a single chart with one interaction (reading a point), so there are no commands to search
skip.reset: a fixed chart with no editable state to reset
skip.json-round-trip: a fixed chart with no editable state; its data is published as the visual's data file
skip.markdown-export: a fixed chart with no session state to copy as Markdown; its narrated deck is checked by beamdswitch-export
